description: List every submission waiting for review at once, or only the given ids (from list_submissions). A feed already in the directory comes back as existing; one failure does not stop the rest. Returns counts listed / existing / failed and a result per id. Needs an OpenAccess bearer with scope submissions:review.

ids.description: Only these submissions. Omit for all waiting.

reason.description: A note for the review log.
